summary: Sites, hookups, facilities, mid-April to mid-October confirmed; cleared 'reservable via MyCountyParks', which neither county page supports. No county rate found.
flags: NO RATE: neither county page posts a camping fee. Only secondary: Wanderlog/ParkAdvisor reviews say $20-25, undated, not written. The county has web pages, so no camper-report fallback; office 563-927-3410.

BOOKING: stored reservable + the inclusion evidence say 'reservable' on mycountyparks; the park page lists no camping facility to book and the county says self-registration. Cleared rather than set to FCFS, since no page says 'no reservations'.

WATERFRONT LEAD, unresolved: stored 'not waterfront' has no evidence text. Esri z18 at 42.4426,-91.4098: the Maquoketa is about 90 m wide; the southern sand loop's edge is about 40-70 m back through trees and a day-use lawn, and pads are mostly under canopy. The county's campground map PDF is named on the park page but I could not find its link. Stays not waterfront unless the map shows pads closer; riverview is the most it could earn.
Pin about 170 m east of the loops; fine.
note: Delaware County Conservation Board park (170 acres) 3 mi SE of Manchester on the Maquoketa River. Trout stream and river fishing; Maquoketa River Water Trail terminus. --Claude
